title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Koenigsegg Gemera

scenes.text: The Koenigsegg Gemera was revealed in March twenty twenty with a tiny three-cylinder engine making six hundred horsepower. Six years later, as production finally began, that engine was gone from the order book. Two things most people do not know about the Gemera: how that engine worked, and how much the car changed on the way to production. Every figure here is sourced.
scenes.caption: 2 THINGS YOU DIDN'T KNOW ABOUT THE KOENIGSEGG GEMERA

scenes.text: We used Wikipedia's pages on the Gemera, the Regera and Koenigsegg, a March twenty twenty-six report on AOL, Motor1, InsideHook, SlashGear and Jalopnik. The sources disagree on power, weight and motor counts in several places. We show the disagreements. Our own arithmetic is labelled.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: WIKIPEDIA · AOL (30 MAR 2026) · MOTOR1 · INSIDEHOOK · SLASHGEAR · JALOPNIK · DISAGREEMENTS ARE SHOWN · OUR ARITHMETIC IS LABELLED

scenes.text: Thing one. Wikipedia says the original Gemera engine was a two-litre twin-turbo inline three, called TFG, with Freevalve and no camshaft. It made six hundred horsepower at seventy-five hundred revs and six hundred newton-metres. By our arithmetic, that is three hundred horsepower per litre, from a three-cylinder engine you could lift out and carry.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 2.0 L TWIN-TURBO INLINE-3 'TFG' WITH FREEVALVE (NO CAMSHAFT) · 600 HP @ 7,500 RPM · 600 N·M (443 LB-FT) · 600 ÷ 2.0 = 300 HP/L (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 'COULD CARRY' = OUR FIGURE OF SPEECH, NO WEIGHT GIVEN
scenes.chapter: Thing one: the engine with no camshaft

scenes.text: A note on the nickname. The Wikipedia page says only TFG and never spells it out. Motor1's headline called the twenty twenty car a three-cylinder model. InsideHook says it was nicknamed Tiny Friendly Giant. We use that name, as one source gives it, and we note the Wikipedia page itself does not.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 'TFG' (NOT SPELLED OUT) · INSIDEHOOK (29 JULY 2024): 'TINY FRIENDLY GIANT (TFG)' · MOTOR1 HEADLINE: 'THREE-CYLINDER MODEL'

scenes.text: Freevalve means the valves are controlled without a camshaft. Wikipedia lists it for the engine and gives no further explanation, and none of our other sources describe how it works. So we say what the sources say: the engine has no camshaft. We will not explain a mechanism that our sources do not describe.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 'FREEVALVE (NO CAMSHAFT)' · HOW IT WORKS: NOT DESCRIBED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: With the electric side, the combined system output was 1,400 horsepower for the three-cylinder version, according to Wikipedia. By our arithmetic, that means the electric motor supplies eight hundred, which matches the 800 horsepower Dark Matter motor on the front axle. The three-cylinder car was claimed to reach one hundred kilometres per hour in one point nine seconds.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: I3 VERSION COMBINED 1,400 HP · 1,400 − 600 = 800 HP ELECTRIC (OUR ARITHMETIC) = 'DARK MATTER' FRONT MOTOR 600 KW (800 HP) · 0–100 KM/H 1.9 S (CLAIMED)

scenes.text: AOL's March twenty twenty-six report gives different original numbers for the twenty twenty reveal: one thousand six hundred seventy-seven horsepower and twenty-five hundred eighty-one pound-feet, with the three-cylinder plus three electric motors. Wikipedia mentions one thousand seven hundred brake horsepower in one citation and one thousand six hundred seventy-seven in a headline. So the original claim has two versions.
scenes.caption: AOL (30 MAR 2026): 2020 REVEAL — 2.0 L I3 + 3 ELECTRIC MOTORS = 1,677 HP / 2,581 LB-FT · WIKIPEDIA CITATIONS: 1,700 BHP IN ONE SOURCE, 1,677 HP IN ANOTHER HEADLINE

scenes.text: The geometry of the car is unusual. Wikipedia lists a wheelbase of three thousand millimetres, a length of forty-nine seventy-five, a width of nineteen eighty-eight and a height of twelve ninety-five. By our arithmetic, that is nearly sixteen and a half feet long, and just over four feet tall. It is a four-seater with two doors and no B-pillar.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: WB 3,000 · L 4,975 · W 1,988 · H 1,295 MM = 16.3 FT LONG, 4.25 FT TALL (OUR CONVERSIONS) · 2 DOORS, 4 SEATS, NO B-PILLAR, DIHEDRAL SYNCHRO-HELIX DOORS

scenes.text: The doors are dihedral synchro-helix, Wikipedia says, and there are four seats. It is the first four-seater from Koenigsegg, and Wikipedia calls it a two-door, four-seat coupé or sports saloon. Top Gear's cited headline calls it a Mega GT, and Wikipedia classes it as a grand tourer. Koenigsegg did not, in our sources, publish a rear-seat legroom number.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: FIRST KOENIGSEGG FOUR-SEATER · 2-DOOR, 4-SEAT COUPÉ / 'SPORTS SALOON' · TOP GEAR CITED HEADLINE: 'MEGA GT' · REAR LEGROOM: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Features include four touchscreens, three-zone climate control, eleven speakers, all-wheel drive and steering, torque vectoring and an Akrapovič titanium exhaust, Wikipedia lists. Wheels are twenty-one by ten and a half inches at the front and twenty-two by eleven and a half at the rear, with Michelin Pilot Sport 4S as standard or Michelin Cup 2R.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 4 TOUCHSCREENS · 3-ZONE CLIMATE · 11 SPEAKERS · AWD + AWS · TORQUE VECTORING · AKRAPOVIČ TITANIUM EXHAUST · 21×10.5 FRONT, 22×11.5 REAR · MICHELIN PILOT SPORT 4S OR CUP 2R

scenes.text: Then the cup holders. Wikipedia lists eight, four heated and four cooled. The page does not claim a world first, and our other sources do not either, so we do not. It is simply a number: eight cup holders in a car with four seats, which by our arithmetic is two per seat.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 8 CUP HOLDERS (4 HEATED, 4 COOLED) · NO 'WORLD FIRST' CLAIM IN OUR SOURCES · 8 ÷ 4 SEATS = 2 PER SEAT (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Thing two. The Gemera that is now in production is not the one shown in twenty twenty. AOL says that in twenty twenty-three the three electric motors were replaced by a single eight-hundred-horsepower motor, cutting weight and complexity. Combined output dropped to fourteen hundred horsepower and thirteen hundred sixty-four pound-feet, down from the original sixteen seventy-seven and twenty-five eighty-one.
scenes.caption: AOL (30 MAR 2026): 2023 — 3 MOTORS → 1 × 800 HP; 'CUTTING WEIGHT AND COMPLEXITY' · COMBINED 1,400 HP / 1,364 LB-FT vs ORIGINAL 1,677 / 2,581
scenes.chapter: Thing two: the car that changed

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the change cuts peak power by seventeen percent and peak torque by forty-seven percent for the three-cylinder car. Those are the sources' own numbers. They do not say whether drivers would notice, and the claimed zero to one hundred of one point nine seconds is listed for the three-cylinder version.
scenes.caption: 1,677 → 1,400 HP = −16.5% · 2,581 → 1,364 LB-FT = −47.2% (OUR ARITHMETIC; AOL + WIKIPEDIA FIGURES) · 0–100 KM/H 1.9 S LISTED FOR THE I3

scenes.text: Wikipedia's weights tell another story. It lists a kerb weight of nineteen eighty-eight kilograms for the twenty twenty prototype and twenty forty-two for the twenty twenty-three production car. By our arithmetic, the production car is fifty-four kilograms heavier, or nearly three percent, even though AOL says the revision cut weight. The sources conflict, and the page does not explain.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 1,988 KG (2020 PROTOTYPE) vs 2,042 KG (2023 PRODUCTION) = +54 KG = +2.7% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · AOL SAYS THE REVISION CUT WEIGHT → SOURCES CONFLICT; EXPLANATION NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: The spec table also conflicts. Wikipedia's table lists a single Dark Matter motor on the front axle, while the text describes three motors, one on the front and one per rear wheel, with the rear ones at five hundred horsepower each. By our arithmetic, eight hundred plus two five hundreds is eighteen hundred, which does not match fourteen hundred. The page is describing two different versions.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA TABLE: ONE DARK MATTER MOTOR (FRONT, 600 KW / 800 HP) · TEXT: THREE MOTORS (FRONT + 2 REAR AT 373 KW / 500 HP EACH) · 800 + 500 + 500 = 1,800 HP (OUR ARITHMETIC) ≠ 1,400 → TWO VERSIONS ON ONE PAGE

scenes.text: Then the engine itself. Wikipedia says the three-cylinder option was dropped in July twenty twenty-four due to a lack of demand. AOL says that in twenty twenty-three Koenigsegg stated nearly every customer chose the V8. InsideHook, on the twenty-ninth of July twenty twenty-four, quotes Christian von Koenigsegg saying there were so few left asking for a three-cylinder.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: I3 DROPPED JULY 2024, 'A LACK OF DEMAND' · AOL: 2023 — NEARLY EVERY CUSTOMER CHOSE THE V8 · INSIDEHOOK: von KOENIGSEGG — 'THERE WERE SO FEW LEFT THAT ASKED FOR A THREE-CYLINDER' (COMPANY HAD PERSUADED THE HOLDOUTS)

scenes.text: The V8 version is a twin-turbo five-litre running on E85, with combined output of twenty-three hundred horsepower and twenty-seven fifty newton-metres, Wikipedia says. By our arithmetic, subtracting the eight-hundred-horsepower motor leaves fifteen hundred for the engine. Car and Driver's headline, cited on Wikipedia, says twenty-two sixty-nine, so the exact figure differs by source.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 5.0 L TWIN-TURBO V8 ON E85 · 2,300 HP · 2,750 N·M (2,028 LB-FT) · 2,300 − 800 = 1,500 HP FROM THE V8 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · CAR AND DRIVER HEADLINE: 2,269 HP

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the V8 car's twenty-three hundred horsepower is sixty-four percent more than the three-cylinder car's fourteen hundred. It uses a nine-speed Light Speed Tourbillon Transmission, a modified version of the Jesko's gearbox, Wikipedia says. InsideHook quotes Autoblog calling it smaller, lighter and better than the Jesko's. That is the outlet's opinion.
scenes.caption: 2,300 ÷ 1,400 = +64.3% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · WIKIPEDIA: 9-SPEED LIGHT SPEED TOURBILLON TRANSMISSION (LSTT), MODIFIED JESKO GEARBOX · INSIDEHOOK / AUTOBLOG: 'SMALLER, LIGHTER, BETTER' (OPINION)

scenes.text: Battery and range: Wikipedia lists an eight-hundred-fifty volt, fourteen kilowatt-hour battery. Total range is fourteen hundred sixty-three kilometres, or nine hundred nine miles, and electric range is fifty kilometres, or thirty-one miles. Top speed is claimed at four hundred kilometres per hour for the three-cylinder car, and three hundred in electric mode.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 850 V, 14 KWH · TOTAL RANGE 1,463 KM (909 MI) · ELECTRIC 50 KM (31 MI) · TOP SPEED 400 KM/H (I3 CLAIM) · 300 KM/H (186 MPH) ELECTRIC MODE

scenes.text: Timing is part of the story. Wikipedia says the Gemera was unveiled on the third of March twenty twenty, online, at the cancelled Geneva Motor Show, and was originally scheduled for production in twenty twenty-two. AOL reports on the thirtieth of March twenty twenty-six that production has begun, according to a post on Facebook.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: UNVEILED 3 MARCH 2020 (ONLINE, CANCELLED GENEVA SHOW) · ORIGINALLY SCHEDULED FOR 2022 · AOL (30 MAR 2026): PRODUCTION BEGUN, PER A FACEBOOK POST BY KOENIGSEGG
scenes.chapter: Six years from reveal to production

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, production began about four years after the originally scheduled date and six years after the reveal. AOL says the Gemera is built alongside the CC850, and that the Sadair's Spear will soon join them. It gives no delivery timeline.
scenes.caption: 2022 → 2026 = ~4 YEARS LATE · 3 MAR 2020 → 30 MAR 2026 ≈ 6 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC) · AOL: BUILT ALONGSIDE CC850; 'SADAIR'S SPEAR' TO JOIN · DELIVERY TIMELINE: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: AOL says production is limited to three hundred cars and that every example is already accounted for. Wikipedia says production will be limited to three hundred. Neither names a customer. Koenigsegg's own planning says the Gemera is sold out, but we have no independent count of signed orders or of deposits. That is a company claim.
scenes.caption: AOL: LIMITED TO 300 · 'EVERY EXAMPLE ALREADY ACCOUNTED FOR' · WIKIPEDIA: LIMITED TO 300 · CUSTOMER NAMES / INDEPENDENT ORDER COUNT: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Even before production, build slots were being sold. Motor1, in April twenty twenty, reported that a McLaren dealer in Charlotte, North Carolina, was listing a gray Gemera with an orange interior and VIN zero zero one, selling a build slot. The listing did not mention the price. It was six years before production began, by our arithmetic.
scenes.caption: MOTOR1 (13 APR 2020): McLAREN CHARLOTTE LISTED A BUILD SLOT — GRAY, ORANGE INTERIOR, VIN 001 · PRICE NOT MENTIONED · ~6 YEARS BEFORE PRODUCTION (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The same Motor1 report says Christian von Koenigsegg told Top Gear the U.S.-spec Gemera starts at one point seven million dollars. InsideHook, in July twenty twenty-four, repeats a base price of one point seven million, from Auto Express, and a rumoured four hundred thousand dollars extra for the V8. The author notes the total of two point one million is his own calculation.
scenes.caption: MOTOR1: von KOENIGSEGG TO TOP GEAR — U.S.-SPEC FROM $1.7 M · INSIDEHOOK (29 JULY 2024): BASE $1.7 M (AUTO EXPRESS) + RUMOURED $400,000 FOR V8 = ~$2.1 M (AUTHOR'S SUM, ASSUMES THE EXTRA APPLIES TO THE BASE)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, four hundred thousand on one point seven million is twenty-four percent. That is if the rumour is right, which InsideHook labels as rumoured. We have no official price list for the production car, and Wikipedia's Gemera page does not give a price at all, so this is the best we can say.
scenes.caption: $400,000 ÷ $1,700,000 = 23.5% (OUR ARITHMETIC; RUMOURED) · OFFICIAL PRODUCTION PRICE LIST: NOT IN OUR SOURCES · WIKIPEDIA GEMERA PAGE: NO PRICE

scenes.text: Where does the Gemera sit in the line-up? Wikipedia's Koenigsegg page lists the Jesko with twelve hundred eighty-one horsepower on petrol and sixteen hundred three on E85, the CC850 with a new shift system that won a Top Gear innovation award in twenty twenty-three, and the Gemera. As of twenty twenty-six, it names the Jesko, Gemera and CC850 as the current line-up.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (KOENIGSEGG): JESKO 1,281 HP PETROL / 1,603 HP E85, 1,500 N·M, 9-SPEED LSTT · CC850 (2022–) — TOP GEAR INNOVATION AWARD 2023 FOR ITS ESS SHIFT SYSTEM · 2026 LINE-UP: JESKO, GEMERA, CC850

scenes.text: The company is small but growing. Wikipedia says staff numbered forty-five in two thousand eight and just under eight hundred at the end of twenty twenty-three. In July twenty twenty-three a new factory opened near the old one, doubling production capacity. By our arithmetic, that is a seventeen-fold increase in staff in fifteen years.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 2008 STAFF 45 · END-2023 JUST UNDER 800 · JULY 2023 NEW FACTORY, DOUBLING CAPACITY · 800 ÷ 45 ≈ 17.8× IN 15 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: In two thousand eight, Wikipedia says the company produced eighteen cars at an average price of about one million dollars each. By our arithmetic, that is about eighteen million dollars of cars. The Gemera alone, three hundred cars at one point seven million, would be five hundred ten million dollars of base price, if every one is sold at that price.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 2008 — 18 CARS, AVG ~$1 M = ~$18 M · 300 × $1.7 M = $510 M (OUR ARITHMETIC; BASE PRICE, ASSUMES ALL AT $1.7 M; OPTIONS EXCLUDED) · 510 ÷ 18 = 28×

scenes.text: And the Regera, the earlier hybrid hypercar, is a point of reference. Wikipedia says Koenigsegg planned eighty and built eighty-five, and sold out on the thirteenth of June twenty seventeen, two years after its Geneva unveiling. The Gemera has so far taken six years from unveiling to production, by our arithmetic three times as long as the Regera took to sell out.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (REGERA): PLANNED 80, BUILT 85 (PAGE ALSO SAYS 80 IN THE INFOBOX) · SOLD OUT 13 JUNE 2017 · UNVEILED MARCH 2015 → ~2 YEARS · GEMERA 6 YEARS TO PRODUCTION = 3× (OUR ARITHMETIC; DIFFERENT MILESTONES)

scenes.text: To judge the Gemera's numbers, put them next to its older sibling. Wikipedia says the Regera has a five-litre twin-turbo V8 making eleven hundred horsepower, or fifteen hundred on E85, plus three electric motors of six hundred ninety-seven horsepower. Its combined output is fifteen hundred in the infobox and seventeen ninety-seven in the text. Even for the Regera, one page gives two totals.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (REGERA): 5.0 L TWIN-TURBO V8 1,100 HP (1,500 HP ON E85) · 3 YASA MOTORS 697 HP · COMBINED 1,500 HP (INFOBOX) vs 1,797 HP (TEXT) → PAGE CONFLICTS WITH ITSELF
scenes.chapter: How the numbers compare with the Regera

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the Gemera's V8 version at twenty-three hundred horsepower is fifty-three percent above the Regera's fifteen hundred infobox figure, and twenty-eight percent above the seventeen ninety-seven figure. Which one you pick depends on which Regera number you trust. We show both, because our source shows both.
scenes.caption: 2,300 ÷ 1,500 = +53.3% · 2,300 ÷ 1,797 = +28.0% (OUR ARITHMETIC; BOTH REGERA FIGURES FROM WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Weight is the other half of the story. Wikipedia lists the Regera at fourteen seventy kilograms dry, fifteen ninety kerb in one place and fifteen seventy in another. The Gemera's kerb weight is twenty forty-two. By our arithmetic, the Gemera is between four hundred fifty-two and four hundred seventy-two kilograms heavier, roughly thirty percent more.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REGERA 1,470 KG DRY · 1,590 KG / 1,570 KG KERB · GEMERA 2,042 KG KERB (2023) · 2,042 − 1,590 = 452 KG; 2,042 − 1,570 = 472 KG; ≈ +28–30% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Power to weight, by our arithmetic, using kerb weights and Wikipedia's power numbers: the Gemera V8 car gives about one point one three horsepower per kilogram, and the Regera, at fifteen hundred and fifteen ninety, about zero point nine four. The figures are only as reliable as the sources. Neither company publishes a test of both cars side by side, as far as our sources say.
scenes.caption: GEMERA V8: 2,300 ÷ 2,042 = 1.13 HP/KG · REGERA: 1,500 ÷ 1,590 = 0.94 HP/KG (OUR ARITHMETIC; MIXED SOURCES) · SIDE-BY-SIDE TEST: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Acceleration claims: Wikipedia says the Regera does zero to one hundred in two point eight seconds and zero to four hundred and back to zero in twenty-eight point eight one seconds, set in June twenty twenty-three. The Gemera's claim is one point nine seconds, for the three-cylinder version that is no longer offered. For the V8 car, our sources give no zero to one hundred time.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REGERA 0–100 KM/H 2.8 S · 0–400–0 KM/H 28.81 S (16 JUNE 2023, ÖREBRO) · GEMERA 0–100 1.9 S (I3, NO LONGER OFFERED) · V8 0–100: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: The company was founded in nineteen ninety-four by Christian von Koenigsegg, who was twenty-two, and Wikipedia says he raised sixty million Swedish kronor from investors. It started in Olofström and moved to Ängelholm in the early two-thousands. By our arithmetic, it took about twenty-six years from founding to the Gemera's reveal in twenty twenty.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: FOUNDED 1994 BY CHRISTIAN von KOENIGSEGG, AGE 22 · KR 60,000,000 FROM INVESTORS · OLOFSTRÖM → ÄNGELHOLM EARLY 2000s · 1994 → 2020 = 26 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)
scenes.chapter: The people and the company behind it

scenes.text: Not every year was smooth. Wikipedia reports that in June two thousand nine Koenigsegg signed a letter of intent to buy Saab, with six hundred million dollars backing from the European Investment Bank, and withdrew in November. A Chinese company, BAIC, took a minority stake in two thousand nine, and in January twenty nineteen, twenty percent was sold to NEVS for one hundred seventy-one million dollars. The company bought that stake back in twenty twenty-one.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: SAAB LETTER OF INTENT JUNE 2009 ($600 M FROM THE EUROPEAN INVESTMENT BANK), WITHDRAWN NOV 2009 · BAIC MINORITY STAKE 2009 · 20% TO NEVS FOR $171 M (JAN 2019) · STAKE BOUGHT BACK 2021

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the NEVS price of one hundred seventy-one million dollars for twenty percent implies a value of eight hundred fifty-five million dollars for the whole company, if the percentage and price are both exact. Wikipedia does not give a company valuation, so that is our own multiplication, not a published figure.
scenes.caption: $171 M ÷ 0.20 = $855 M (OUR ARITHMETIC; ASSUMES ROUNDED 20% AND $171 M ARE EXACT) · COMPANY VALUATION: NOT STATED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Records belong to the story too. Wikipedia says the Agera RS reached a four hundred forty-seven point one nine kilometre-per-hour average and four hundred fifty-seven point nine four instrumented, in November twenty seventeen at Pahrump. By our arithmetic, the four hundred forty-seven average is two hundred seventy-eight miles per hour. The Gemera is not claimed to be a record car, and none of our sources say it is.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: AGERA RS 447.19 KM/H AVG (278 MPH, OUR CONVERSION) · 457.94 KM/H INSTRUMENTED · 4 NOV 2017, PAHRUMP · GEMERA RECORD CLAIM: NONE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Wikipedia adds one more record: the Jesko Attack lap time of one minute twenty-four point eight six seconds at Laguna Seca, on the eighteenth of August twenty twenty-four. The Jesko shares the Gemera's gearbox lineage, as the Gemera's nine-speed transmission is described as a modified version of the Jesko's. But the Jesko's record says nothing directly about how the Gemera drives.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: JESKO ATTACK — LAGUNA SECA 1:24.86 (18 AUG 2024) · GEMERA 9-SPEED LSTT DESCRIBED AS A MODIFIED JESKO GEARBOX · GEMERA LAP TIME: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: There is no Gemera running cost in our sources, so we use the nearest figure we have. An RM Sotheby's catalogue for a twenty twenty Regera, sold at Monterey in twenty twenty-four, reports third-year service and updates in spring twenty twenty-four costing nearly nineteen thousand dollars, including a technician flown in from Sweden. That is the Regera, not the Gemera.
scenes.caption: RM SOTHEBY'S (MONTEREY 2024, LOT 240, 2020 REGERA): THIRD-YEAR SERVICE + UPDATES, SPRING 2024, 'NEARLY $19,000', INCLUDING A TECHNICIAN FLOWN FROM SWEDEN · THIS IS A REGERA, NOT A GEMERA · GEMERA SERVICE COST: NOT IN OUR SOURCES
scenes.chapter: What an owner would actually face

scenes.text: The same catalogue lists options of about five hundred one thousand dollars on that Regera, including a one hundred seventy thousand dollar clear carbon finish. The estimate was two point seven five to three point two five million, and the car did not sell. By our arithmetic, that estimate is between one point eight and one point nine times the Gemera's one point seven million base price.
scenes.caption: RM SOTHEBY'S LOT 240: OPTIONS ≈ $501,330 (CLEAR CARBON $170,000) · ESTIMATE $2.75–3.25 M · RESULT: NOT SOLD · $2.75 M ÷ $1.7 M = 1.6; $3.25 M ÷ $1.7 M = 1.9 (OUR ARITHMETIC; DIFFERENT CARS)

scenes.text: The catalogue also notes a detail about buying: California rules require such a car to be sold to a dealer or an out-of-state resident. That is a note about the Regera sale, and we do not know whether it applies to the Gemera. We include it because it shows how the paperwork around these cars can affect the buyer pool, not because it is a Gemera rule.
scenes.caption: RM SOTHEBY'S (REGERA LOT): CALIFORNIA REQUIRES SALE TO A DEALER OR OUT-OF-STATE RESIDENT · APPLIES TO GEMERA: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Fuel is a number we can compute. The V8 runs on E85, Wikipedia says, and the car has a 1,463-kilometre total range. We do not have a published tank size, so we cannot turn that into a mile-per-gallon figure. Our sources give a range, not a consumption. That is the honest limit: we will not invent a tank capacity.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: V8 ON E85 · TOTAL RANGE 1,463 KM (909 MI) · TANK SIZE / MPG: NOT IN OUR SOURCES → NO CONSUMPTION FIGURE COMPUTED

scenes.text: A few details from the Wikipedia page are easy to miss. The car has an optional Ghost package, named after the ghost emblem Koenigsegg uses. The page lists the package without describing its contents, and none of our other sources describe it either. So we can say it exists, and we cannot say what it changes.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: OPTIONAL 'GHOST' PACKAGE LISTED · CONTENTS: NOT DESCRIBED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: The tyres are named: Michelin Pilot Sport 4S as standard, or Michelin Cup 2R as an option. The Pilot Sport 4S is the road tyre, and the Cup 2R is the track-oriented one. That description of the two tyres is general knowledge, not from our sources, which only list the names. The page gives no tyre prices and no expected tyre life.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: MICHELIN PILOT SPORT 4S (STD) / CUP 2R (OPTION) · ROAD vs TRACK DESCRIPTION = GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, NOT FROM OUR SOURCES · TYRE PRICE / LIFE: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: The wheels are different sizes front and rear: twenty-one inches at the front and twenty-two at the rear. By our arithmetic, a one-inch difference in diameter is about two and a half centimetres on the wheel alone. Wikipedia gives the widths as ten and a half and eleven and a half inches, so the rear wheel is a full inch wider.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 21×10.5 IN FRONT, 22×11.5 IN REAR · 1 IN = 2.54 CM (OUR CONVERSION) · REAR IS 1 IN LARGER IN DIAMETER AND 1 IN WIDER

scenes.text: Back to the Freevalve engine. In the three-cylinder car, six hundred horsepower came from a two-litre unit, and the system output of fourteen hundred had to be delivered through a gearbox and all-wheel drive. Wikipedia describes all-wheel drive and all-wheel steering together with torque vectoring. How the power splits between axles is not described in our sources.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: AWD + ALL-WHEEL STEERING + TORQUE VECTORING · FRONT/REAR POWER SPLIT: NOT DESCRIBED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Efficiency claims are another gap. Wikipedia and AOL give a total range of fourteen sixty-three kilometres and an electric range of fifty. By our arithmetic, the electric part is only three point four percent of the total range, so the car is meant to be driven mostly by its engine, with electric power for short trips and for boosting.
scenes.caption: 50 ÷ 1,463 = 3.4% (OUR ARITHMETIC; WIKIPEDIA FIGURES) · INTERPRETATION 'MOSTLY ENGINE-DRIVEN' = OUR READING OF THE FIGURES

scenes.text: One more number: the battery is fourteen kilowatt-hours at eight hundred fifty volts. By our arithmetic, fifty kilometres on fourteen kilowatt-hours is about zero point twenty-eight kilowatt-hours per kilometre, or four-point-five kilowatt-hours per ten miles, which is heavy compared with the small hybrids most people know. It is a performance car, and the range is a side benefit.
scenes.caption: 14 KWH ÷ 50 KM = 0.28 KWH/KM (OUR ARITHMETIC; ASSUMES FULL USABLE CAPACITY) · 'HEAVY COMPARED WITH SMALL HYBRIDS' = GENERAL OBSERVATION, NO COMPARISON FIGURE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: So the two things to remember are these. First, the engine that defined the Gemera's debut, a camshaft-free three-cylinder making three hundred horsepower per litre, is no longer on the order form. Second, the car that reached production is a different, simpler hybrid, with one big electric motor, a V8, and a price that sources put near one point seven million dollars before options.
scenes.caption: RECAP: (1) I3 TFG ENGINE DROPPED JULY 2024 · (2) 2023 REVISION: 3 MOTORS → 1 × 800 HP; V8 NOW THE ENGINE · BASE ≈ $1.7 M (MOTOR1; INSIDEHOOK) · OPTIONS EXTRA

scenes.text: What is missing. An official production price. The weight of the final production car, which Wikipedia lists but AOL contradicts on direction. Independent performance tests of the production Gemera. How many of the three hundred are V8 and how many were converted from three-cylinder. If you have a primary source for any of these, tell us in the comments.
scenes.caption: NOT IN OUR SOURCES: OFFICIAL PRODUCTION PRICE · RECONCILED PRODUCTION WEIGHT · INDEPENDENT TESTS OF THE PRODUCTION CAR · V8 / I3 SPLIT OF THE 300 · DELIVERY DATES
scenes.chapter: What the sources do not say

scenes.text: So: the three-cylinder that made three hundred horsepower per litre is gone, and the car shown in twenty twenty has been rebuilt around one electric motor and a V8. In the other videos of this series, we compare the Gemera with the Regera, count what Koenigsegg ownership costs, and tell why the cars are built in a fighter-jet hangar. Subscribe to Pickup Reality.
